status: PROPOSED - not applied. Approve, edit or reject each entry before it becomes an archetype assignment file.
how_used: Each entry is matched against the Madden '95 source by name/team/position (historical_ratings.matching). Anything not 'matched' goes to manual review. 'expected_team_1994' is what a shipped 1994 preseason roster should show; a different team is a roster-basis finding, not something to correct silently.

players.rationale: Late-career (age 37 in 1994) pocket passer; also a roster-basis marker (traded HOU->MIN April 1994).

players.rationale: Left-handed scrambling QB with significant rushing production; mobility is a documented trait, not inferred from passing yards.
